repair.subject: Repair Request: Leaking Kitchen Sink
repair.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to report a repair issue in the kitchen: the sink has been leaking since last night.

Please let me know how you would like to proceed and whether you need any further details or access arrangements.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,
